annotations.title: AI company due-diligence report: KYB, ownership, risk

description: AI KYB and vendor due-diligence report on a company from its domain, name or US ticker: identity, GLEIF ownership (parents, subsidiaries), business, SEC XBRL financials copied from filings, recent 8-K events, domain registration, email DNS, website security headers and OFAC screening of the entity and related companies, plus risk ratings, red flags and open questions, quotes checked against cited sources. Written by Anthropic Claude; takes 1-2 minutes; not investment advice. Price: $0.75 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged. AI-generated answer; a call with no arguments returns the stored example answer without a model call.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key (1 to 10 digits) instead of ticker; needs domain or name as well.

domain.description: Company website domain or URL, e.g. apple.com. Matched to Wikidata and GLEIF, and used for registry RDAP, email DNS and a live HTTPS security-header check. Give domain, name or ticker.

name.description: Company name, 2 to 100 characters, e.g. Apple Inc. Matched to Wikidata labels and GLEIF exact legal names.

ticker.description: US stock ticker for SEC EDGAR filings and XBRL financials, e.g. AAPL. When omitted, a US listing on Wikidata whose SEC registrant name matches is used. Mutually exclusive with cik.
